articles.headline: Ghana's Brandon Thomas-Asante showing why he belongs in the Premier League with Coventry
articles.description: The Black Stars forward's journey has taken him from non-league football and the lower reaches of the English pyramid to the Premier League with Coventry City and now, to the biggest stage of all - representing Ghana in the World Cup knockouts.
